preconditions.description: The length of the permutation n is between 1 and 50.
k is between 1 and the minimum of 10^18 and the length of Kyoya's list l.

postconditions.description: The output permutation has exactly n elements.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output permutation is between 1 and n.
All elements in the output permutation are distinct.
The output permutation remains unchanged after converting to and from its standard cyclic representation.
